trusted_execution.prerequisite: git archive origin/<default_branch> src/plate_core and .agentic/policy-runtime.json into PLATE_POLICY_PYTHONPATH; fail closed if verify fails. No PR workspace fallback. Run gate CLIs from PLATE_POLICY_RUN_DIR with PYTHONNOUSERSITE=1. Workflow pinning on main or plate-lifecycle App is a separate deploy step.

plate_core_wheel.note: PyPI plate-core==max_known_published_version does not yet ship integration-base gates; adopters must vendor src/plate_core on default branch until a newer wheel is published.
